title: Modbus register write rejected: Illegal Function
description: Reports a parsed Modbus responder rejecting FC06 or FC16 with Illegal Function (01). The guard requires protocol ID zero, MBAP length three and raw exception function 0x86 or 0x90. Each matching response writes a standard notice with connection, transaction and unit context.

topics.title: Load Modbus and Notice scripts
topics.description: @load imports the base Modbus analyzer scripts and the Notice framework. Modbus supplies parsed protocol events and ModbusHeaders. The Notice framework supplies Notice::Type, Notice::ACTION_LOG and the NOTICE call used below.

topics.title: Scope exported identifiers
topics.description: module ModbusWriteRejection places subsequent declarations in this namespace. The exported notice member therefore has the fully qualified name ModbusWriteRejection::Register_Write_Illegal_Function. Namespace qualification keeps the four rejection types distinct while their handlers share the same protocol event.
links: Use the member in a notice record

topics.title: Declare the notice type
topics.description: export exposes the enclosed declaration to other scripts. redef enum Notice::Type += extends the existing framework enumeration with Register_Write_Illegal_Function. The later $note assignment selects this classification, which appears in the note field of notice.log.

topics.title: Handle a parsed responder exception
topics.description: event modbus_exception declares a handler with a connection c, a ModbusHeaders record named headers and an exception code of type count. Zeek supplies this event from its responder exception parser after TCP stream reassembly. The header and reason provide the inputs for this stateless check.

ranges.code:
# The pinned native parser dispatches ModbusTCP_ExceptResponse only on
# the responder branch. HeaderToVal preserves the raw exception FC.
# Each parsed ADU raises its own event after TCP stream reassembly.
event modbus_exception(c: connection, headers: ModbusHeaders, code: count)
{

topics.title: Match the register write rejection
topics.description: The if expression joins the protocol ID, MBAP length, exception reason and function checks with &&. All conditions must hold. Parentheses group the two function alternatives joined by ||. A matching reply enters the NOTICE block; each parsed response receives its own evaluation.
links: Require an exception length of three

topics.title: Construct the notice record
topics.description: NOTICE receives a record written with square brackets and named $field assignments. $note selects Register_Write_Illegal_Function from the extended Notice::Type enumeration. The following fields attach connection context, formatted evidence and the chosen logging action.

topics.title: Attach the connection context
topics.description: $conn=c passes the connection from the protocol event into Notice::Info. The framework derives the connection UID and originator/responder endpoint fields from this record. The Modbus unit identifier is supplied separately from headers$uid in the subject.
links: Read the Modbus transaction and unit fields
Receive the connection in the event

topics.title: Format the notice message
topics.description: fmt fills %02d with the base function obtained by subtracting 0x80 from the raw exception function. The width and leading zero display FC06 or FC16. $msg combines that function with the reported Illegal Function (01) reason.

ranges.code:
$msg=fmt("Modbus responder rejected register write FC%02d with Illegal Function (01)",
headers$function_code - 0x80),

links: Follow the base function through both formats

topics.title: Define the subject fields
topics.description: $sub receives a formatted string with six %d placeholders. The literal labels name transaction_id, unit_id, function_code, exception_code, protocol_id and mbap_length. fmt fills them from the following arguments in the same order.

topics.title: Supply transaction and unit values
topics.description: The $ operator reads fields from the headers record. headers$tid supplies the transaction ID and headers$uid supplies the Modbus unit ID. headers$function_code - 0x80 supplies the base register write function. These are the first three values inserted into $sub.
links: Keep unit and connection identifiers distinct

topics.title: Supply reason and framing values
topics.description: code, headers$pid and headers$len supply the last three %d values in $sub. They record the selected exception reason, protocol ID and declared MBAP length. Their displayed values follow directly from the same fields evaluated by the guard.

topics.title: Select the standard log action
topics.description: set(Notice::ACTION_LOG) constructs an action set containing the Notice framework logging action. $actions assigns it to this notice. The framework writes the notice through standard notice.log using the active logging configuration.

topics.title: Emit each matching application message
topics.description: $suppress_for=0secs sets the suppression interval to zero. Repeated matching application messages and reused transaction IDs can each produce notices. Zeek handles TCP retransmissions during stream reassembly. The final brackets, parenthesis and braces close the notice record, call, guard and event body.

topics.title: Require protocol ID zero
topics.description: headers$pid == 0 compares the MBAP protocol identifier with the Modbus value zero. == is an equality comparison. Its Boolean result forms one term of the && expression and the selected identifier is also written into $sub.

topics.title: Require MBAP length three
topics.description: headers$len == 3 requires a unit identifier, exception function and exception code, one byte each. MBAP length counts these bytes after the six-byte transaction, protocol and length prefix. The explicit comparison fixes the accepted exception framing at this size.
links: Combine length with the other fields

topics.title: Select Illegal Function (01)
topics.description: code == 1 selects the responder's Illegal Function exception report. code has type count and carries the parsed exception byte as a nonnegative integer. The same value becomes exception_code in $sub and determines this script's notice classification.

topics.title: Select register write exception functions
topics.description: 0x86 selects the exception response for FC06, Write Single Register. 0x90 selects the response for FC16, Write Multiple Registers. || accepts either alternative. FC16 is decimal 16 with base function 0x10; the raw exception functions include the 0x80 exception bit.

topics.title: Convert exception functions for display
topics.description: The guard accepts raw exception functions 0x86 and 0x90. Subtracting 0x80 supplies the base function for both fmt calls. %02d formats it in $msg with two decimal digits; %d records the same function value in $sub.

msg: Modbus responder rejected register write FC
